name: Apollo 11 Lunar Module descent stage
description: The lower stage of the Lunar Module remained on the Moon after the crew's ascent stage lifted off.
science: It formed part of the landing system that brought the first crew to the lunar surface in 1969.
story: The Lunar Module had two stages. The ascent stage carried astronauts back to orbit; the descent stage stayed on the surface. A machine built for one journey became a lasting trace of that visit.

name: Sojourner rover
description: A small rover that explored near the Pathfinder lander in 1997 and communicated through its base station.
science: Sojourner demonstrated surface mobility and returned observations of Martian rocks and soil.
storyTitle: The little rover that changed the plan
story: Sojourner was designed as a technology demonstration. Its success showed how a rover could inspect nearby terrain, helping make mobile exploration a key part of later Mars missions.
